_source: Real investigation_graph.invoke() run against the Neon dev branch for transaction 843 (Meridian Duty-Free Traders, SCRUM-65's planted triple-rule fraud, seeded user_id 2), captured 2026-09-29 for SCRUM-52. amount_deviation's category_mean/category_stdev were captured by independently replicating app.rules.amount_deviation's own history walk for this transaction's category (shopping) as of its timestamp -- the rules engine doesn't expose these structurally yet (see validation.py's payload-shape docstring); everything else here is exactly what the graph itself returned, unmodified.
